notes:
- The Laboratory has a second floor: a tall stairwell off one side of the lab leads up a full flight of
  stairs (6.4 m) to an upper wing of 4 more lab rooms (bio labs, cryo storage, server rooms, archives,
  incubation, security, the director's office). Doors up there open with points like downstairs, and wall buys,
  perk machines, the box and intel files can all turn up on the upper floor.
- No windows upstairs: the only way in is the stairwell, so zombies have to come up the stairs after you.
  A good place to hold out, as long as nothing comes up behind you.
- Behind the scenes, every room now has a floor height, ready for the caves under the Laboratory next.
